name: Listing Revenue Report
purpose: Estimates nightly revenue per neighbourhood from listing prices and availability

inputs.host_id: ID of the host who runs the listing
inputs.listing_title: Title the host wrote for the listing
inputs.borough: Borough of New York City the listing is in
inputs.neighbourhood: Neighbourhood within the borough that the listing is in
inputs.nightly_price: Price for one night, in dollars
inputs.days_available: Number of days in the year the listing can be booked
inputs.last_review_date: Date of the listing's most recent review
inputs.cleaning_fee: Fee charged for cleaning after each stay
inputs.guest_rating: Average star rating guests gave the listing
